title: pityopsis oligantha
intro: Pityopsis oligantha, commonly known as Riddell's goldenrod, is a flowering plant native to North America. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Pityopsis oligantha are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
